title: AgentOutput
description: What one run returns to the caller. The real deliverable is the Markdown file at artifacts.test_plan_md; this object is the machine-readable receipt. No external writes (Q6).

status.description: ok = plan produced and passed validate_plan. validation_failed = plan produced but still failed validation after one repair (bad scenarios dropped; see human_review_gate). fetch_failed = no plan: any hard failure before/at the model call (Jira 401/403/404, redact/budget refusal, Groq error) - the stage is in errors[].

test_plan_md.description: out/test-plan-<KEY>.md — repo template, DRAFT, HUMAN REVIEW GATE. On fetch_failed this is a stub (header + reason).

plan_model_json.description: out/test-plan-<KEY>.json — the validated PlanModel. Null on fetch_failed.

cached_tokens.description: Groq usage.prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens on the main call.

response_mode.description: Which Groq response_format actually produced the plan.

warnings.description: Non-blocking validate_plan warnings (e.g. an AC with only positive scenarios).

message.description: Human-readable. MUST NOT contain the Jira token or any secret.
